auth.terms: Site n'imepụta akaụntụ, ị kwenyere na <terms>Usoro ojiji</terms>.
auth.dataNotice: Glazecalc bụ ọrụ n'efu, isi mmalite mepere emepe, a na-edebekwa akaụntụ na sava dị na United States. Ị nwere ike ịgụ ntuziaka ma nwaa ihe ngụkọ n'enweghị akaụntụ, ma ọ bụ gbaa mbipụta nke gị. Ma ị ga-emepụta akaụntụ ebe a bụ mkpebi nke gị, ọrụ ahụ anaghị anabata ọrụ ọ bụla maka ya. <where>Ebe a na-edebe akaụntụ gị, na nhọrọ gị</where>

secondStep.leadRecovery: Tinye otu n'ime koodu mgbake i chekwara mgbe ị gbanyere mbanye nzọụkwụ abụọ. Koodu ọ bụla na-arụ ọrụ otu ugboro.

account.keepText: A ga-ewepụ nnwale a na ihe niile dị n'ime ya na {date}. Mepụta akaụntụ n'efu iji debe ha: usoro glaze gị, ihe gị na ndetu gị na-anọ otu ha dị, {name} na-anọkwa dịka aha ngosi gị.
account.title: Akaụntụ gị
account.passwordHint: Opekata mpe mkpụrụedemede 8. A ga-ewepụ ngwaọrụ ndị ọzọ banyere n'akaụntụ a.
account.changeFailed: Njehie: enweghị ike ịgbanwe okwuntughe ahụ. Biko nwaa ọzọ.
account.deleteText: Nke a na-ewepụ akaụntụ gị na ihe niile ị chekwara: usoro glaze, ihe, ihe mgbakwunye, ndetu, ndekọ ọkụ na ndụmọdụ. A gaghị enwe ike ịmehie ya.
account.deleteFailed: Njehie: enweghị ike ihichapụ akaụntụ ahụ. Biko nwaa ọzọ.
account.unverifiedText: Anyị zigara njikọ na {email} mgbe i mere akaụntụ a. Mepee ya iji kwado na adreesị ahụ bụ nke gị. Ruo mgbe ahụ, anyị na-eziga ozi na ya naanị mgbe ị rịọrọ, dịka ịtọgharị okwuntughe.
account.resendFailed: Njehie: enweghị ike iziga njikọ ahụ. Biko nwaa ọzọ.
account.emailText: Anyị na-eziga njikọ na adreesị ọhụrụ ahụ, email gị na-agbanwekwa mgbe i mepere ya. Anyị na-agwakwa adreesị gị ugbu a. A ga-ewepụ ngwaọrụ ọ bụla banyere n'akaụntụ a.
account.emailFailed: Njehie: enweghị ike iziga njikọ ahụ. Biko nwaa ọzọ.
account.signOutText: Na-ewepụ gị na ngwaọrụ ọ bụla, gụnyere nke a, ma na-akwụsị token nnweta gị na njikọ nkesa gị. Jiri ya ma ọ bụrụ na ngwaọrụ furu gị ma ọ bụ i chere na onye ọzọ nwere mbanye gị.
account.signOutFailed: Njehie: enweghị ike ịpụ. Biko nwaa ọzọ.
account.confirmStep: Mbanye nzọụkwụ abụọ gbanyere, ya mere kwado na ọ bụ gị: okwuntughe gị na nzọụkwụ nke abụọ.

mfa.heading: Mbanye nzọụkwụ abụọ
mfa.intro: Rịọ nzọụkwụ nke abụọ mgbe ị na-abanye, tinyere okwuntughe gị: koodu si na ngwa authenticator, ma ọ bụ passkey. Mgbe ahụ onye matara okwuntughe gị ka enweghị ike ịbanye.
mfa.loadFailed: Enweghị ike ibugo mbanye nzọụkwụ abụọ gị. Biko bugharịa ibe ahụ.
mfa.onText: Ị na-abanye site n'okwuntughe gị na nzọụkwụ nke abụọ, ma ọ bụ site na passkey naanị.
mfa.offText: Iji gbanye ya, hazie ngwa authenticator ma ọ bụ tinye passkey.
mfa.confirmEmailFirst: Kwado email gị mbụ, n'elu. Anyị na-eji ya agwa gị maka mgbanwe n'otu ị si abanye, na inyere aka ma ọ bụrụ na nzọụkwụ nke abụọ gị efuo.
mfa.appText: Ngwa dị na ekwentị gị ma ọ bụ na ihe njikwa okwuntughe gị na-egosi koodu ọhụrụ kwa sekọnd 30, iji tinye mgbe ị na-abanye.
mfa.passkeysText: Passkey na-eme ka ị banye site na mkpịsị aka gị, ihu gị ma ọ bụ mkpọchi ihuenyo, na ngwaọrụ a ma ọ bụ ekwentị gị. Ọ nwere ike ịbụ nzọụkwụ nke abụọ gị, ma ọ bụ mee ka ị banye n'onwe ya, n'enweghị okwuntughe gị.
mfa.noPasskeysHere: Brawza a enweghị ike ịme ma ọ bụ iji passkey. Nwaa brawza ma ọ bụ ngwaọrụ ọzọ.
mfa.name: Aha maka passkey ahụ
mfa.nameHint: Ka i nwee ike ịmata passkey gị iche, dịka "Laptop" ma ọ bụ "Ekwentị".
mfa.nameCheck: Nye passkey ahụ aha nwere mkpụrụedemede 1 ruo {most}.
mfa.passkeyLimit: I nwere passkey {most}, nke kacha akaụntụ nwere ike inwe. Wepụ otu iji tinye ọzọ.
mfa.codesLeft: {count, plural, other {Koodu mgbake # n'ime {total} fọdụrụ.}} Ọ bụrụ na ị nweghị ike iji ngwa gị ma ọ bụ passkey, koodu na-eme ka ị banye kama. Koodu ọ bụla na-arụ ọrụ otu ugboro.
mfa.codesLow: Mee koodu ọhụrụ n'oge na-adịghị anya. Ọ bụrụ na ha agwụ ma ngwa gị na passkey gị efuo, ị gaghị enwe ike ịbanye.
mfa.offWhat: Mbanye nzọụkwụ abụọ na-anọ na-agbanye mgbe i nwere ngwa authenticator ma ọ bụ passkey. Iwepụ nke ikpeazụ n'ime ha na-agbanyụ ya, mgbe ahụ:
mfa.offPassword: Ịbanye chọrọ naanị okwuntughe gị, ya mere onye ọ bụla matara ya nwere ike ịbanye.
mfa.offCodes: Koodu mgbake gị na-akwụsị ịrụ ọrụ.
mfa.offSignOut: A na-ewepụ ngwaọrụ ọ bụla ọzọ banyere n'akaụntụ gị. Nke a na-anọ n'ime.
mfa.offEmail: Anyị na-ezitere gị email na a gbanyụrụ ya.
mfa.offRemoveApp: Gbanyụọ mbanye nzọụkwụ abụọ (na-ewepụ ngwa ahụ)
mfa.offRemoveAppFirst: Wepụ ngwa ahụ, iji malite ịgbanyụ ya
mfa.offPasskeys: {count, plural, other {Iji gbanyụọ ya, wepụ passkey # gị n'okpuru Passkey, n'elu.}}
mfa.offPasskeysToo: {count, plural, other {I nwekwara passkey #: wepụ ha n'okpuru Passkey, n'elu, tinyere ngwa ahụ.}}
mfa.addAppText: Iji hazie ngwa authenticator, kwado mbụ na ọ bụ gị.
mfa.removeAppText: Iji wepụ ngwa authenticator, kwado na ọ bụ gị.
mfa.addPasskeyText: Nye passkey ahụ aha ma kwado na ọ bụ gị. Mgbe ahụ brawza gị ga-arịọ gị ime passkey ahụ.
mfa.removePasskeyText: Iji wepụ passkey "{name}", kwado na ọ bụ gị.
mfa.newCodesText: Koodu ọhụrụ na-anọchi nke ochie gị, ndị na-akwụsị ịrụ ọrụ. Kwado na ọ bụ gị.
mfa.lastFactor: Nke a bụ nzọụkwụ nke abụọ ikpeazụ gị, ya mere mbanye nzọụkwụ abụọ na-agbanyụ, koodu mgbake gị na-akwụsịkwa ịrụ ọrụ.
mfa.passkeyNext: Brawza gị ga-arịọ passkey gị mgbe ị gara n'ihu.
mfa.passkeyReadyText: Daalụ. Ugbu a mee passkey "{name}": mgbe ị pịrị bọtịnụ ahụ, brawza gị ga-arịọ mkpịsị aka gị, ihu gị ma ọ bụ mkpọchi ihuenyo, ma ọ bụ ekwentị gị. Ọ bụrụ na ọ rụghị ọrụ, ị nwere ike ịnwa ọzọ ruo nkeji {minutes} n'akwadoghị ọzọ.
mfa.failed: Njehie: enweghị ike ime mgbanwe ahụ. Biko nwaa ọzọ.
mfa.setupOpen: Mepee ngwa authenticator gị ma họrọ itinye akaụntụ.
mfa.setupScan: Jiri ngwa ahụ nyochaa koodu QR a, ma ọ bụ pịnye igodo ahụ.
mfa.setupTap: Pịa bọtịnụ ahụ iji tinye Glazecalc na ngwa authenticator ma ọ bụ ihe njikwa okwuntughe na ekwentị a.
mfa.showQr: Gosi koodu QR, iji hazie ya na ngwaọrụ ọzọ
mfa.setupScanOther: Jiri ngwa authenticator dị na ngwaọrụ nke ọzọ nyochaa ya.

mfa.setupCode: Tinye koodu nwere ọnụọgụ {digits} ngwa ahụ na-egosi ugbu a maka Glazecalc
mfa.codesText: Debe ndị a n'ebe dị nchebe, dịka ihe njikwa okwuntughe gị, ma ọ bụ bipụta ha ma debe ha ya na akwụkwọ gị. Ọ bụrụ na ị nweghị ike iji ngwa gị ma ọ bụ passkey, koodu na-eme ka ị banye kama. Koodu ọ bụla na-arụ ọrụ otu ugboro. A na-egosi ha naanị ugbu a.
mfa.printNote: Koodu ọ bụla na-arụ ọrụ otu ugboro. Debe ibe a n'ebe dị nchebe.

export.heading: Budata data m
export.text: Chekwaa mbipụta ihe niile akaụntụ gị nwere dịka otu faịlụ: nkọwa gị, ntọala, ihe ị nwere n'aka, usoro glaze, ihe, ihe mgbakwunye, ndetu, ndekọ ọkụ, ndụmọdụ na ebe mkpofu. O nweghị okwuntughe gị. Debe faịlụ ahụ n'ebe nzuzo, n'ihi na o nwere ihe niile i chekwara.
export.csvText: Ma ọ bụ chekwaa spreadsheet nke naanị usoro glaze gị ma ọ bụ naanị ihe nke gị, iji mepee na Excel, Numbers ma ọ bụ Sheets.

trash.heading: Ebe mkpofu
trash.text: Ihe i wepụrụ n'akwụkwọ ndetu gị na-eche n'Ebe mkpofu ruo ụbọchị 30. Weghachi ya site n'ebe ahụ, ma ọ bụ hichapụ ya kpamkpam.

shared.heading: Usoro glaze e kesara
shared.text: Usoro glaze i kesara site na njikọ, nke onye ọ bụla nwere njikọ ahụ nwere ike ịgụ n'enweghị akaụntụ. A na-egosi njikọ naanị otu ugboro, mgbe e mere ya, ya mere a pụghị igosi ya ebe a. Iji kesaa usoro glaze ọzọ, mee njikọ ọhụrụ n'okpuru Ndị ọzọ nke usoro glaze ahụ.

lead.help: Lead (Pb) bụ nsí ma e kuo ya ma ọ bụ loo ya, ọ na-agbakọkwa n'ahụ, glaze nwere lead (Pb) nwekwara ike ịhapụ ya banye na nri na ihe ọṅụṅụ; ọ dịghị ngụkọ nwere ike ịkọ ma ite a gbara ọkụ na-eme ya. Mgbe ọ gbanyụrụ, usoro glaze nwerelarị lead (Pb) ka na-emepe otu ha dị.
lead.warning: Jiri lead (Pb) naanị dịka frit, ọ dịghị mgbe dịka red lead, white lead ma ọ bụ yellow lead ma ọ bụ litharge. Gwakọta ya mmiri mmiri, agbasala ya (spray) mgbe ọ bụla, yiri respirator ma jiri mmiri hichaa. Debe ite nwere glaze lead (Pb) n'ebe nri na ihe ọṅụṅụ na-adịghị, belụsọ ma ite ahụ a gbara ọkụ gafere nnwale ụlọ nyocha maka metal na-esi na ya apụta (leach test).

confirm.heading: Kwado tupu mgbanwe
confirm.intro: Họrọ ma mgbanwe si n'onye inyeaka, ngwa ma ọ bụ token nnweta na-eche ruo mgbe i kwadoro ya ebe a, mgbe ị banyere. Ọ dịghị ihe ọ rịọrọ a na-agbanwe ruo mgbe i mere ya.
